# scripts/ops/Sync-AvdSandboxQueue.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Syncs sandbox-run/v1 test items from an initiating repository's open issues (or a folder of item files) into the private companion repository's sandbox queue (docs/sandbox-runs.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-SourceRepo` | string | no |  | Initiating repository (owner/repo) whose open issues carry sandbox-run/v1 blocks. |
| `-ItemsPath` | string | no |  | Folder of sandbox-run/v1 JSON files. |
| `-IssuesPath` | string | no |  | Offline JSON file of initiating issues (gh issue list --json number,title,body,comments,labels). |
| `-IssueNumber` | int[] | no |  | Optional filter to sync only specific item or issue numbers. |
| `-PrivateRepo` | string | no | `$env:AVD_PRIVATE_REPO` | Private companion repository (owner/repo) where sandbox-run queue issues live. |
| `-HeadSha` | string | no |  | 40-hex commit SHA to resolve @HEAD in item sources; defaults to HEAD of this checkout or -SourceRepo. |
| `-DefaultRegion` | string | no | `$env:SPEND_DEFAULT_REGION` | Default sandbox region; items in another region must include regionReason. |
| `-OutPath` | string | no |  | Optional file path to write the rendered queue issues as JSON. |
| `-DryRun` | switch | no |  | Validate and print the queue issues without calling GitHub. |
